title: CheckMate
subtitle: How can we make critical news literacy more accessible and educational for our youths today?
timeline: Jul 2024 - May 2025 (IS483 Final Year Group Project)
award: 1st Place at Cloud Native Experience Award - Dell Technologies

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.body: CheckMate is an AI-powered news analysis platform that helps users evaluate news sentiments, detect propaganda techniques, and understand article tones quickly through multiple intuitive interfaces. By Team CtrlAltElite 2025.
